summary: Innoviz Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the appointment of Maj. Gen. (Ret.) Yoav Har-Even to its Board of Directors, effective immediately. Simultaneously, James Sheridan resigned as a director after his appointor's rights expired. The board change aims to strengthen defense sector momentum. No price, premium, or deal terms are involved. The abrupt resignation and strategic appointment suggest a focused governance shift, not a routine meeting notice. Watch for potential defense contract announcements or further board realignments.
